Dataify Amazon Comment v1.0.0

- Initial release for submitting Amazon product review collection tasks via Dataify Builder.
- Supports API TOKEN handling with explicit input or environment variable detection.
- Step-by-step workflow with parameter checklist and Markdown table confirmation.
- Uses included Python script (submit_amazon_comment.py) for stable Builder task submission.
- Detailed troubleshooting guidance and user prompts for missing or invalid parameters.
- Always directs users to https://dataify.com/dashboard/ for results after task submission.
